# Widget `function-plot` — Function plot

**Pack:** math

**When to use:** Use to plot a function of x, optionally with up to 3 parameter sliders, to build intuition for its shape.

## Example block

```json
{
  "kind": "widget",
  "type": "function-plot",
  "title": "Function plot",
  "props": {
    "expr": "a * sin(b * x)",
    "xMin": -6.28,
    "xMax": 6.28,
    "params": [
      {
        "id": "a",
        "label": "Amplitude",
        "min": 0.5,
        "max": 3,
        "value": 1
      },
      {
        "id": "b",
        "label": "Frequency",
        "min": 0.5,
        "max": 4,
        "value": 1
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## Props

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `expr` | string | yes |
| `xMin` | number | yes |
| `xMax` | number | yes |
| `params` | array of object (0–3) | no |
| `params[].id` | string (pattern `^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$`) | yes |
| `params[].label` | string | yes |
| `params[].min` | number | yes |
| `params[].max` | number | yes |
| `params[].value` | number | yes |

The validator also checks the cross-field rules (ids that must exist, lengths that must match,
expressions that must parse). Run `npm run validate` after writing a widget.
